primary_effect_estimator: aggregate S_run as defined before GPU; matched estimator sensitivity never substitutes a favorable task test

pre_GPU_rule.STRONG: A1 has all five valid independent Delta-S_run directions matching 9A1, hierarchical 95% CI excludes zero in that direction, and bootstrap 95% lower bound of abs(mean Delta-S)-pooled within-state std is positive. Exact fixed-input/process/reset protocol checks pass. The comparison to measured std is a data-derived equality test, not an arbitrary SNR cutoff. Primary gate always uses specified aggregate S_run; matched-input sensitivity is reported separately.
pre_GPU_rule.PARTIAL: A1 direction is stable at population level (mean sign matches original and more matching than opposing repetitions), but one or more STRONG conditions fail. Ties do not count as matching.
pre_GPU_rule.NOT_SUPPORTED: A1 effect mean does not preserve original direction, matching independent signs do not outnumber opposing signs, or effect vanishes with CI including zero and signs lacking directional consistency. Missing/failed measurements imply INCOMPLETE rather than a fabricated negative.
